name: freelancer-platform-backend
description: Convenience scripts to install and run every microservice locally at once. Each service under this folder remains a fully independent Node app with its own package.json -- this root file does not make them a monorepo/workspace, it just saves typing during local development.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix apiGateway && npm install --prefix authService && npm install --prefix leadService && npm install --prefix clientService && npm install --prefix projectService && npm install --prefix paymentService && npm install --prefix meetingService && npm install --prefix taskService && npm install --prefix documentService && npm install --prefix invoiceService && npm install --prefix notificationService && npm install --prefix dashboardService && npm install --prefix ../Database/migrations
scripts.dev: npm run migrate && concurrently -n gateway,auth,lead,client,project,payment,meeting,task,document,invoice,notification,dashboard -c blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan,white,gray,red,blue,green,yellow,magenta "npm --prefix apiGateway run dev" "npm --prefix authService run dev" "npm --prefix leadService run dev" "npm --prefix clientService run dev" "npm --prefix projectService run dev" "npm --prefix paymentService run dev" "npm --prefix meetingService run dev" "npm --prefix taskService run dev" "npm --prefix documentService run dev" "npm --prefix invoiceService run dev" "npm --prefix notificationService run dev" "npm --prefix dashboardService run dev"
